title: C4 Breach on a Metal Base
description: The classic raid: blow straight through walls and doors to reach the vault or the tamed dinos.
requirements: Plenty of C4 Charges (always bring more than you think)
A tank dino or teammates to cover you
steps: Scout the base and pick the shortest path to the loot (fewest walls).
Deal with turrets first (soak or destroy them) so you can stand next to the walls.
Stack C4 on one wall or door, step back, and detonate together.
Move one layer at a time and re-check for hidden turrets after every breach.
Grab the loot and get out before the defenders respond.
tips: Doors and gates are often weaker targets than walls.
Check your server's structure damage multiplier before counting C4.
author: Starter

title: Turret Soaking with a Stegosaurus
description: Use a tanky dino to make the turrets waste all their ammo before you go in.
requirements: High-health Stegosaurus (use its plate mode for bullet resistance)
Medical Brews or a healing source
Optional: a second soaker to swap in
steps: Put the Stego in the right plate mode to resist the turret damage type.
Walk just inside turret range so they start firing.
Back out and heal when health gets low, then go back in.
Repeat until the turrets stop firing — they are empty.
Send in the raiding team.
tips: Heavy turrets and Tek turrets hit much harder — bring more soakers.
Watch for Plant Species X; it also needs to be soaked or cleared.
author: Starter

title: Rocket Launcher Turret Clear
description: Take out exposed turrets from outside their range before the main push.
requirements: Spyglass or scope to spot turrets
steps: Walk around the base and mark every turret you can see.
Find a spot outside their range with a clear line of sight.
Fire rockets at one turret at a time until it breaks.
Repeat for the other turrets, then move in.
tips: Turrets behind walls or behind other structures won't be reachable — soak those instead.
author: Starter

title: Breaking Tek Structures
description: Tek tier is the hardest to break. You need Tek-level damage and a lot of element.
steps: Soak or destroy all turrets first, especially Tek Turrets.
Choose the thinnest part of the base.
Use Tek Grenades / Tek damage on the same wall until it breaks.
Push through carefully — Tek bases often have multiple layers.
tips: Farm and craft before the raid; running out of element halfway is the #1 fail.
author: Starter

title: Primitive Siege with Catapult / Cannon
description: Great for primitive servers or early-game bases without heavy defenses.
requirements: Cannon with Cannon Balls (for tougher walls)
A dino or teammate to guard the siege weapon
steps: Place the siege weapon out of the defenders' range.
Aim at one wall and keep firing until it breaks.
Guard the weapon — it's the first thing defenders try to destroy.
Rush in once there's a hole.
tips: Place it behind cover or on high ground so it's harder to hit.
author: Starter

title: Early Game Grenade Raid on Thatch/Wood
description: Cheap and fast way to break weak early-game bases.
steps: Throw grenades at the doors or walls.
Repeat until the structure breaks.
Loot the storage boxes quickly.
tips: Thatch breaks to almost anything; don't waste grenades on it.
author: Starter
